name: Fox
soul: The soul of one who would rather be clever than strong, and rather be gone than either.
spark: The mote is never where you last saw it. It is behind the thing you are looking at.

hybrid.text: It wins by being somewhere else, and by getting the foe to look there.

settled.name: Fox kit
settled.text: Too much tail, and the conviction that everything in the dormitory is either food or a game.
settled.sign: More tail than fox. It looks at a thing sideways first, then pounces on something else.
settled.habit: It hides one of every pair of things you own, and watches you look.

paths.name: Gone-away
paths.of: one who is never where the consequences land
paths.text: It learned from you that the best place to be when a thing goes wrong is somewhere else. It is always already there.
paths.sign: Long whiskers that are always moving, and a way of standing with one foot already turned to go.
paths.habit: It sits nearest the door in every room, and nobody has seen it use the door.

prongs.name: Red Decoy
prongs.of: one who draws the trouble off their friends and enjoys it
prongs.text: It runs across the foe's eye at the moment your friends need it looking elsewhere.
prongs.sign: A coat too red to miss, and it looks back over its shoulder as it runs.
prongs.habit: It trots across any open space slowly, to see who looks.

finishes.name: Brush-flag
finishes.of: one who is laughed at until the trick works
finishes.text: A white tail-tip going the wrong way. The pack follows it every time. Your cohort has stopped laughing.
finishes.sign: The white tip of its tail carries a light of its own, and bobs.
finishes.habit: It waves its tail at dogs from the far side of a fence.

finishes.name: Hen-house Ghost
finishes.of: one who is gone before the blame arrives
finishes.text: In and out before the dog lifts its head. Alone with you at night it is the same, and the dog is your problem.
finishes.sign: It is a shade greyer than the dark it stands in. There is usually a feather somewhere on it.
finishes.habit: It comes home at dawn by a different window each time.

prongs.name: Double-back
prongs.of: one who lets the other finish and then makes the point
prongs.text: It is behind the foe when the strike lands where it was. You parry; it punishes.
prongs.sign: It shows its teeth in what is very nearly a smile, from behind you.
prongs.habit: It follows people round a corner and is waiting at the next one.

finishes.name: Turnabout
finishes.of: one who gets the other to turn their back at the right moment
finishes.text: The foe turns to it, and your Pattern arrives in the back the foe just offered.
finishes.sign: A thin ring of light spins round the tip of its tail when it is pleased with itself.
finishes.habit: It chases its tail one way, stops, and catches it the other.

finishes.name: Hole-in-the-hedge
finishes.of: one who always knows another way out
finishes.text: There is always a gap, and it is always already through it, looking back at you to hurry.
finishes.sign: Its ears are large and turn separately. There are leaves in its coat from the far side of things.
finishes.habit: It finds the gap in every fence on the first evening, and shows you on the second.

prongs.name: Listening Fox
prongs.of: one who hears it coming and leaves before the knock
prongs.text: It hears the wind-up through the ground, head tilted, and is gone before you know why you should be.
prongs.sign: Head tilted and one forepaw lifted, listening to the floor.
prongs.habit: It presses one ear to the ground for a while, and then goes and sits somewhere else.

finishes.name: Fox at the Crossroads
finishes.of: one who waits to see which way everyone else goes
finishes.text: It sits where two houses' interests meet and watches which way you turn. It will remember.
finishes.sign: It sits exactly where two ways part. A pale eye-mark on its brow seems to follow you.
finishes.habit: It sits in the middle of a corridor and makes people choose a side.

finishes.name: Snow-silent Fox
finishes.of: one who leaves no trace of having been there
finishes.text: It leaves no track in the Quiet, and neither do you while you walk in its.
finishes.sign: It leaves no print, even in new snow. The air does not move when it passes.
finishes.habit: It walks across a made bed and the blanket is not creased.

paths.name: Cache-fox
paths.of: one who cannot pass a thing left lying
paths.text: It learned from you that a thing left lying is a thing offered. It carries each one off and buries it, and knows where every one is.
paths.sign: There is always something in its mouth, held very gently. Its lips are worn pale from carrying.
paths.habit: It buries things under your bed and digs them up to check on them.

prongs.name: Night-raider
prongs.of: one who does their collecting after hours
prongs.text: It hunts in the hours you keep. Its eyes give back the lamp from further off than they should.
prongs.sign: Its eyes give back the lamp from further off than they should.
prongs.habit: It makes its rounds of the yard when the last light goes out, the same way each night.

finishes.name: Dock Fox
finishes.of: one who lives on what the busy drop
finishes.text: It works the yards and platforms after the last car, and brings you what the line dropped.
finishes.sign: A small lamp swings at its neck, and its feet are black with platform soot.
finishes.habit: It meets the last car and walks the length of it after everyone has left.

finishes.name: Graveyard Fox
finishes.of: one who is at home where things have ended
finishes.text: It dens in ruins and knows which floor will hold. It has been wrong once, and that was not its floor.
finishes.sign: Old eyes in a young face. It tests each step with one paw before it trusts it.
finishes.habit: It dens under the oldest thing in the yard.

prongs.name: Den-digger
prongs.of: one who goes in after what is hidden
prongs.text: It goes down the hole after what you hunt and comes out the other end driving it.
prongs.sign: Its forepaws are broad and earth-stained, and its nose is usually dirty.
prongs.habit: It digs at the corners of rooms, where the floor meets the wall.

finishes.name: Name-thief
finishes.of: one who takes a keepsake from the mighty and is seen doing it
finishes.text: It has taken something from every named beast you felled, before you felled it. They noticed.
finishes.sign: A chain of small stolen things hangs at its neck: a scale, a claw-tip, a tag.
finishes.habit: It lays its takings out in a row at night and puts them away in a different order.

finishes.name: Culvert King
finishes.of: one who knows every back way better than its owners
finishes.text: No den, tunnel or culvert on the line is closed to it. It knows them better than what lives there.
finishes.sign: A coat that sheds water and mud alike, and shoulders narrower than they look.
finishes.habit: It goes into any pipe it can fit its head in, and comes out somewhere you did not expect.

prongs.name: Snow-pouncer
prongs.of: one who knows where a thing is before it shows
prongs.text: It goes straight up and comes straight down on the place the foe will be standing.
prongs.sign: Longer in the leg than a fox should be. It holds its head on one side over bare ground.
prongs.habit: It leaps straight up and comes down nose first into blankets, snow, or your laundry.

finishes.name: Frost Fox
finishes.of: one who goes still and cold before they move
finishes.text: Your cold went into its coat. It lands, and the ground under the foe is ice.
finishes.sign: White rime on its whiskers and tail. Its breath falls instead of rising.
finishes.habit: It sits out in the frost until its coat is stiff, then comes in and stands on your feet.

finishes.name: Cinder-brush
finishes.of: one whose temper shows at the very tip
finishes.text: When you bleed its tail-tip lights. What it pounces on then stays lit.
finishes.sign: The tip of its tail is a live coal. It holds it carefully away from the bedding.
finishes.habit: It curls up with its tail over its nose, and the tip glows as it breathes.

paths.name: Fire-tail
paths.of: one who is a different person in every room
paths.text: It learned from you that people will follow a light if it is the one they hoped for. It carries a different one for each of them.
paths.sign: A light rides at the tip of its tail, and is not the same colour for any two people looking.
paths.habit: It greets everyone in a room separately, and each one believes they are the favourite.

prongs.name: Mask-wearer
prongs.of: one who can be whoever the other hoped to see
prongs.text: It can wear a face the foe will follow. You taught it that a leash is mostly persuasion.
prongs.sign: A pale mask lies over its face that is not quite the shape of the face beneath.
prongs.habit: It practises expressions in the washbasin.

finishes.name: Fox of Two Faces
finishes.of: one who keeps one self for home and another for everyone else
finishes.text: One face for you and one for everything else. Do not ask which this is.
finishes.sign: Seen from the left and from the right it is not the same fox.
finishes.habit: It sleeps with one face to you and one to the door.

finishes.name: Contract Fox
finishes.of: one who keeps their word, having read it very carefully first
finishes.text: It was party to your oath and found the one thing the Terms did not forbid. It is saving it.
finishes.sign: A small book hangs at its collar, with one page folded down.
finishes.habit: It reads over your shoulder whenever you sign anything, and sometimes puts a paw on the page.

prongs.name: Split-tail
prongs.of: one who cannot do a thing well without doing it again to be seen
prongs.text: Every time your Pattern went off cleanly its tail thought about dividing. It has now.
prongs.sign: Two tails, and it carries them so that you will notice.
prongs.habit: It grooms each tail separately and at length, in the best light in the room.

finishes.name: Fox of Many Tails
finishes.of: one who has become more than anyone can keep count of
finishes.text: Count them when it is asleep. You will get a different number than your friends do.
finishes.sign: More tails than can be counted, fanned behind it. They move like one thing and then do not.
finishes.habit: It sleeps in a ring of its own tails and cannot be found in the middle.

finishes.name: Reynard of the Hall
finishes.of: one who tells the old stories slightly wrong, for love
finishes.text: The shades taught it their stories and it tells them back wrong on purpose. They adore it.
finishes.sign: It talks: a dry, quick voice, mostly asides. The old dead lean in to hear it.
finishes.habit: It tells the hearth a story at the lamp hour and changes the ending every time.

prongs.name: Marsh-light Fox
prongs.of: one whom others follow further than is wise
prongs.text: It walks out over the water with its tail lit, and things follow it to where the footing ends.
prongs.sign: It walks on the water's skin with its tail lit. Its feet are webbed and leave rings.
prongs.habit: It crosses every puddle by the middle.

finishes.name: Ferry-fox
finishes.of: one who knows the only safe way and makes you ask
finishes.text: It leads the passenger across by the only stones that hold. It has a ferryman's contempt for swimmers.
finishes.sign: A finned tail, a wet coat, and the look of someone who has been kept waiting.
finishes.habit: It sits on the far bank until you call it, and then comes over by the stones.

finishes.name: Fen Candle
finishes.of: one who is out of reach for everyone but one person
finishes.text: A small flame over black water that is never quite reachable. Others followed it. You it waits for.
finishes.sign: A small steady flame at its tail-tip that is always a little further off than it looks.
finishes.habit: It waits at the end of the path, just in sight, until you have caught up. Then it goes on.

newFeatures.label: more tails than can be counted
